_note: Isaac brain declarations - the analog of fail2drive multi_model_eval/models.yaml (JSON, not YAML: these tools run stdlib-only under the isaacsim env). Keyed by the brain id used in family manifests; the slug names campaign cell dirs/tags, so it is FROZEN once a campaign has run with it (campaign_isaac_v01 pinned x_mobility -> xm). A brain without a server entry runs serverless.
_note_identity: F18 (2026-09-13): each entry DECLARES what runs, in the vocabulary scl_core.agent_identity validates (the same reader as models.yaml): `agent` (the runner script under aisle_gauntlet/), `conda_env` (the inference server's env, measured at campaign start), `cwd` and `agent_config` relative to the brains root (--brains-root / $SCL_BRAINS_ROOT / ~/xmobility_brain), `source` (implementation URL + commit, weights URL + kind + sha256), `environment_extensions` (distribution versions the environment record names). install_models.py installs TO this; evaluate_models.py measures the disk against it and refuses a difference; the install-time brain_manifest.json is a cross-check, never the source. No min_compute_capability yet: NVIDIA's floor for Isaac Sim 5.1 is to be read from the requirements page before it is declared (the P5000, 6.1, is known not to run it; that is a finding, not a floor). Parked as S18 (parked_features, 2026-09-13). `runtime` (F54, 2026-09-28): the env recipe install_models.py builds for `conda_env` (python, torch + torch_index, pins and/or a requirements file of the checkout, no_deps, an optional load_check command run in the checkout) - data, one recipe function for every brain; `server` (script under aisle_gauntlet/, port, distinct per brain; the checkpoint is passed by the runner from `agent_config`, the interpreter measured from conda_env); `slug` (the cell-directory tag, frozen once a campaign ran with it); no install-time manifest any more. torch_builds (F53, 2026-09-27): the registry-level table, per card architecture (sm_<N>), of the torch build install_models.py applies to an entry that accepts it (accepts_torch_builds) when the pinned wheel carries no kernels for the measured GPU - of the table's packages, those the env already holds; evaluate_models.py refuses such an environment at preflight, before Kit starts. The same table as models.yaml (a test keeps them equal), the same core decision.

x_mobility_vis_full.note: SCL X-Mobility v0.1 'vis_full_policy' (Gino, packaged 2026-09-26, released 2026-09-28): fine-tuned from the stock checkpoint 339c68f9 on 17 expert demonstrations from ar_006 (fm_isaac_001) and ar_008 (fm_isaac_003); ar_007 (fm_isaac_004) was never trained on. Whole model adapted (DINOv2, world model, policy, semantic decoder with an eighth OTHER_OBSTACLE class), then the policy heads. Same inputs as the stock brain (front-left camera, signed speed, straight route, previous action). Declared 2026-09-28 (F54).

x_mobility_fusion_v3.note: SCL X-Mobility v0.1 'fusion_v3' (Gino, packaged 2026-09-26, released 2026-09-28): fine-tuned from the stock checkpoint 339c68f9 on the same 17 demonstrations from ar_006 (fm_isaac_001) and ar_008 (fm_isaac_003) plus 1,157 shadow-expert corrections; ar_007 (fm_isaac_004) was never trained on. Policy heads only (command_fc, path_fc, self_attn), perception frozen. Same inputs as the stock brain. Declared 2026-09-28 (F54).
